description: Saves an episode’s Ania Script: { titulo, cenas: [{ id, layout, conteudo, falas: [{ id, texto }] }] } (project fields such as apresentadores, marca or formato may be overridden). It is validated with the renderer’s own schema first: on errors NOTHING is saved and the problems come back (in Portuguese) for you to fix and call again; warnings are returned after saving. Layout ids come from studio_listar_layouts and must match the format (v-* only in 9:16). conteudo.tipo: "abertura" {titulo, subtitulo?}, "cartao" {titulo, itens[]} (each item appears when the speech says it), "imagem" {src}, "broll" {src, legenda?, itens[]}, "video" {src}. Files (src, cena.fundo, fala.real[].src) must be the user’s own, sent first with studio_enviar_midia and written as "midia/<name>" (e.g. {"tipo":"imagem","src":"midia/capa.jpg"}); web links are not read here. Pronunciations go in lexico {"word":"spoken form"}. Write calm speech (short sentences), one idea per scene. No presenter (apresentador "nenhum"): every scene uses foco-total (16:9) or v-cheia (9:16). Recorded presenter (apresentador "video", gravacao): each scene with speech gets "gravacao": "midia/cena-N.mp4" — the clip of the user reading exactly that scene’s falas; the reply lists the text to show the user for each recording and which clips are still missing (a missing clip is a warning now, an error at render). Free.

language.description: The user's language as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'). Replies and prices follow it.

revisao.description: Revision you read (studio_ver_episodio); refused if it changed since.

roteiro.description: The episode script (Ania Script v1 without schema/projeto).
